title: ESA press release: Ariane 501 — Presentation of Inquiry Board report
summary: ESA official presentation of the Ariane 501 Inquiry Board report, used as the official-source anchor for the Ariane 5 Flight 501 record.

source_payload.identifier: Ariane 501 - Presentation of Inquiry Board report
source_payload.copyability: not embedded in this revision; linked and line-located only
extraction_notes: ESA summarizes the chain of events and states that the failure came from loss of guidance and attitude information due to specification and design errors in inertial-reference-system software.
ESA also highlights inadequate representative testing/simulation and an alignment function that was not useful after liftoff.

handling_notes: Uncrewed launch failure; avoid simplified ridicule of software engineers or project teams.
